name: Enabled:UMCI
meaning: Restricts both kernel-mode and user-mode binaries (default: kernel-mode only); enabling validates user-mode executables and scripts.

name: Enabled:Boot Menu Protection
meaning: Not currently supported.

name: Required:WHQL
meaning: Requires every kernel driver to be WHQL-signed and removes legacy driver support (default allows non-WHQL-signed drivers to run).
notes: Drivers built for Windows 10 should be WHQL certified.

name: Enabled:Audit Mode
meaning: Default option. Logs what would be blocked without enforcing; delete this option to enforce the policy.
notes: Recommended to test policies before enforcement.

name: Disabled:Flight Signing
meaning: If enabled binaries from Windows Insider builds are not trusted.
notes: For organizations that only want released Windows builds.

name: Enabled:Inherit Default Policy
meaning: Reserved for future use; currently has no effect.

name: Enabled:Unsigned System Integrity Policy
meaning: Default option. Allows the policy to remain unsigned; removing it requires the policy (and any supplemental policies) to be signed.
notes: Trusted update signers go in UpdatePolicySigners; trusted supplemental signers go in SupplementalPolicySigners.

name: Allowed:Debug Policy Augmented
meaning: Not currently supported.

name: Required:EV Signers
meaning: Not currently supported.

name: Enabled:Advanced Boot Options Menu
meaning: Allows the F8 preboot menu to appear to a physically present user (disabled by default for all App Control policies).

name: Enabled:Boot Audit on Failure
meaning: When enforced and a boot-critical driver fails to start the policy is placed into audit mode so Windows can load.
notes: Admins validate the failure in the CodeIntegrity event log.

name: Disabled:Script Enforcement
meaning: Disables script enforcement for PowerShell wscript.exe cscript.exe mshta.exe and MSXML.
notes: Not supported on Windows Server 2016 or Windows 10 1607 LTSB.

name: Required:Enforce Store Applications
meaning: When enabled the App Control policy also applies to Universal Windows (Store) apps.

name: Enabled:Managed Installer
meaning: Automatically allows applications installed by a designated managed installer.

name: Enabled:Intelligent Security Graph Authorization
meaning: Automatically allows applications with known-good reputation per the Intelligent Security Graph (ISG).

name: Enabled:Invalidate EAs on Reboot
meaning: With ISG (option 14) enabled periodically revalidates reputation for files the ISG previously authorized.

name: Enabled:Update Policy No Reboot
meaning: Allows future App Control policy updates to apply without a reboot.

name: Enabled:Allow Supplemental Policies
meaning: Set on a base policy to allow supplemental policies to expand it.

name: Disabled:Runtime FilePath Rule Protection
meaning: Disables the default runtime check that only allows FilePath rules for paths writable only by admins.

name: Enabled:Dynamic Code Security
meaning: Enables policy enforcement for .NET applications and dynamically loaded libraries.
notes: Windows 10 1803+ or Windows Server 2019+ only; enforced system-wide if any UMCI policy enables it; no audit mode.

name: Enabled:Revoked Expired As Unsigned
meaning: Treats binaries signed with revoked certificates -- or expired certificates carrying the Lifetime Signing EKU -- as unsigned for user-mode process/component enterprise-signing scenarios.

name: Enabled:Developer Mode Dynamic Code Trust
meaning: Trusts UWP apps debugged in Visual Studio or deployed through Device Portal while Developer Mode is enabled.
notes: No numeric id given on the page.
